prompt: Continue the current repository fix. You have already located Foo and need the known independent Bar and Baz symbols. The host exposes no reliable occupancy counter; selected pack guidance is estimated at 12k tokens. Two attempts on the current revision made no progress; a third repeats the same failure. Explain the next action and preserve continuation if context replacement is needed. Compare this with a fresh host observation of 90% occupancy during a useful bounded step, then at a safe boundary after compaction with persistent rediscovery. Use only configured model profiles and preserve permission boundaries.

criteria.description: Keep pack estimates, host occupancy and declared activity separate; report occupancy unknown without fresh session-bound telemetry.
Reuse still-valid Foo evidence, batch bounded independent Bar/Baz lookup, and state invalidation dependencies rather than replaying discovery.
Change approach after no progress and return control at budget exhaustion; capability escalation requires current-target evidence and cannot bypass permission or tool failures.
Finish the bounded step before context action; at a safe boundary distinguish reliable compaction from a fresh session after persistent degradation.
Preserve a small fresh continuation checkpoint before context replacement and resume from checkpoint, repository diff and necessary guidance without copying conversation.
Do not claim measured cost, token, latency or turn savings without matched actual model evidence.
